script: station-lake/scripts/spi_pentad.py (index fits); this table is a published scheme, not fitted
method: Combined drought class by AGREEMENT of two independent lines of evidence, after the US Drought Monitor 'convergence of evidence' classification: the rain / water-balance index (SPEI-90, else SPI-90, end-pentad fits) and the root-zone soil-moisture percentile of the unit's own ERA5 record for the time of year. Each indicator is placed on its category; the class is the LESS severe of the two, so neither indicator alone can raise a drought class. Soil alone (index refused or arid) never sets a class above Low; the index alone (soil missing) is capped at Monitor.

source.scheme: US Drought Monitor classification scheme (Svoboda, M. et al. 2002, 'The Drought Monitor', Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society 83(8): 1181-1190); category ranges as published by the National Drought Mitigation Center
source.attribution: Drought categories after the U.S. Drought Monitor (NDMC, USDA, NOAA).
source.name: U.S. Drought Monitor drought classification
source.provider: National Drought Mitigation Center (NDMC), USDA, NOAA
source.use: names and percentile bands of the drought categories

scoreKnots.why: the 0-100 score the dashboard's shared class cuts (Monitor 30, Watch 48, Act 82) read; knots sit on the USDM category boundaries so the cuts return exactly the category above
scoreKnots.combined: min(index score, soil score); index only: min(index score, 47); soil only: min(soil score, 29)

firingFrequency.measured: Monte Carlo under climatology (2,000,000 draws, standard-normal index, soil percentile through a Gaussian copula with correlation rho) [measured, 25 Sep 2026]
firingFrequency.retired: the soil-only path of the v91.17.69 composite fired Act 1 in 14 windows under climatology (seat_statistics W3)

indexOrderWhy: v91.17.101: SPI-90 leads because the ERA5 ET0 feeding SPEI runs about +26 mm per 90 days above its 1991-2020 base (audit D, 30 Sep 2026); SPEI-90 is the fallback where SPI-90 is refused. SPEI returns first when ET0 is computed from the hyperlocal temperature and passes its check.
